notes: Default rule set for ComparisonRuleSet.Default(). Edit or copy this file freely — a custom set is just a JSON file loaded with ComparisonRuleSet.FromFile(path); nothing here needs to change to change what a format check actually requires.

rules.description: Tracked changes must be fully accepted or rejected before the document can pass.
Every review comment must be resolved before the document can pass. (Null — resolution status unknown — also fails this rule, on purpose: an unknown state is not the same as a clean one.)
Page orientation must match the approved template.
Paper size must match the approved template.
Body typeface must match the approved template.
Body font size must match the approved template.
Heading 1 typeface must match the approved template.
